items.title: He Raised 4 Children Alone. When He Died, None Of Them Came to Say Goodbye
items.summary: Ghanshyam died on August 4, 2026. The old-age home informed his family and repeatedly tried to persuade them to come to Bhopal. They responded with excuses.
